hypothesesTested.how: Read the full diff of d2d3648 (#40). It adds exactly one prefix, '/platform', to a startsWith() allowlist used by the GLOBAL session-auth gate. The v1 one-click path (/api/esri/one-click-at-point, gated by a local esriTenant middleware, not this global gate's exempt list) and /api/property-intelligence/summary (requireTenant) do not start with '/platform' or any of the other allowlisted prefixes, so req.path.startsWith(p) cannot match them. Diffed server/routes.ts across the ENTIRE seam (68fe8cc^..332a16c): the only non-additive change is this one line. No session-gated v1 route's auth requirement changed.

Read the full diff of 332a16c (#52). It touches only platformQueryPropertyIntelLayer's wastewater branch in server/routes/esri.ts (adds a `.rings` fallback) plus its own test file. It does not touch platformOneClickAtPoint, the parcels-one-click registry entry, or the session-gated /api/esri/one-click-at-point route. The commit message itself confirms production's own bastrop-infrastructure wastewater route was deliberately left untouched. Unrelated layer, unrelated symptom (wastewater lines/polygons, not parcel click).

Diffed every one of #39-52 that touches server/routes/esri.ts or server/routes/property-intelligence.ts (c6cd8be, 3022f72, 2776b12) against the pre-seam tree (68fe8cc^). Every change to server/routes/property-intelligence.ts is a pure addition after the original registerPropertyIntelligenceRoutes function, which is byte-for-byte unchanged. No seam commit touches server/services/property-intelligence.ts (getPropertySummary) at all. BASTROP_LAYER_REGISTRY['parcels-one-click'] (server/routes/esri.ts:264-268, including its outFields string) is untouched by any of the 14 PRs -- confirmed by grep across every commit's diff in the range.

rootCauseFound.mechanism: External dependency break, not a code regression from the seam. BASTROP_LAYER_REGISTRY['parcels-one-click'].outFields (server/routes/esri.ts:266) is a single hardcoded field list shared by BOTH the v1 session-gated /api/esri/one-click-at-point route and the v2 platformOneClickAtPoint() helper. It has requested a field named 'Ordinance_Link' since 2026-03-05 (git blame: e82f0c28). The City of Bastrop's own ArcGIS Online-hosted layer (services7.arcgis.com/qOeXJdBtGknaCJC4, Parcels_One_Click/FeatureServer/23) no longer has a field by that name: live layer metadata's editingInfo.schemaLastEditDate = 1789071882041ms = 2026-09-10T20:24:42Z. ArcGIS FeatureServer query rejects the ENTIRE outFields list as invalid (400 'outFields parameter is invalid') when even one requested field name does not exist -- there is no partial-field degrade.
evidenceLiveAtSource: curl to the live ArcGIS layer's own metadata (?f=json) lists 59 real fields; 'Ordinance_Link' is not among them (nearest are 'Ordinance_', an ordinance-NUMBER field like '2022-02', and 'OrdRes', both semantically different from a link/URL).

Replicating the app's exact query (same outFields string, a real downtown Bastrop point 30.1102,-97.3153) against the live layer returns: {"error":{"code":400,"message":"Cannot perform query. Invalid query parameters.","details":["'outFields' parameter is invalid"]}}

Removing only 'Ordinance_Link' from that same outFields string and re-running the identical query against the live layer returns 200 with a real parcel (1011 Chestnut St, Bastrop TX, owner TALLEY BOBBIE JEAN, zoning GC District, full setback/zoning fields, real polygon geometry) -- proves the fix live, at source, before writing any code.
rootCauseFound.evidenceLiveThroughTheDeployedApp: Hit the LIVE production v2 route with the real platform-internal-api-key secret: GET https://smartcity-api-7dyaiy7wha-uc.a.run.app/api/platform/property-intel/summary?lat=30.1102&lng=-97.3153 -> HTTP 200, parcel.found=false, oneClickData=null, every parcel-derived summary field blank. platformOneClickAtPoint's own code (`if (data.error || !data.features...) return null`) silently swallows the ArcGIS 400 into a null result rather than surfacing it -- v2 is ALSO broken right now by this exact defect, just silently (a 200 with empty fields) rather than visibly. This is itself a DEV_PROCESS 4.3 violation (silent fallback where an empty result is read as an absence) but is the same root cause, not a second defect, and not in scope to change beyond what the outFields fix already repairs.
rootCauseFound.clientSideConfirmation: client/src/pages/DevelopmentServicesDashboard.tsx's fetchOneClickAtPoint (v1) treats any non-{found:true,data:...} response, including the 502 the v1 server route correctly returns on an ArcGIS query error, identically to 'no parcel here': it clears oneClickData/oneClickLatLng/selectedParcelGeometry and shows nothing. This matches the reported symptom exactly -- staff click a parcel and nothing happens, no dossier, no visible error.

One shared config value; fixes both the v1 route and the v2 platformOneClickAtPoint() helper identically -- does not touch routing, auth, or either route's own code, so it cannot regress the auth-exemption or GIS-parity work the seam shipped.
